sentences.en: It can be dangerous for young people to ride motorcycles.
sentences.zh: 对于年轻人来说骑摩托车可能会很危险。

sentences.en: She cannot ride a motorcycle, not to mention a bicycle.
sentences.zh: 她连自行车都骑不了，更别提摩托车了。

sentences.en: She can ride a motorcycle, not to mention a bicycle.
sentences.zh: 她不仅能骑自行车，还能骑摩托车。
